summary: Beltrami County forest service tower on Ludlow Island; a 1931 newspaper says it was destroyed in fires, but a 1934 survey describes a 70-foot tower; footings were recorded in 1966.

facts.status_note: The Forest Fire Lookout Association county list marks it Tower Gone, with no date; the latest description of remains is a 1966 survey
facts.design: Ladder tower; the 1966 survey describes a four-legged steel structure with an observation room
facts.agency: Minnesota Forest Service, now the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources

events.note: Moorhead newspaper item dated September 12, 1931 reports more than 25 settlers burned out of their homes by fires near Ludlow
Same newspaper says the lookout tower and station on Ludlow Island were completely destroyed; the county list says the first tower may have been destroyed by wildfire
Survey notes describe a 70-foot fire tower at the site; no build date is given
The 70-foot tower was removed by the time of the 1954 survey notes
Survey of the second tower, Fire Tower 86: about 85 feet high with an observation room; footings and octagonal cab remnants at the site

corrections.why: The agency field holds a location code, not an owner. The county list codes the owner as Mn MFS, footnoted as the Minnesota Forest Service, now the DNR. The statewide list gives the location as section 36, township 156N, range 31W, not 157N.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1931 newspaper says the tower and station were completely destroyed. The county list says the 70-foot tower was removed by 1954 and may have been destroyed by wildfire, and a 1934 survey still describes a 70-foot tower. The sources do not settle whether a tower was rebuilt; the story says so.
The county list gives 81 feet for the second tower; the 1966 survey says about 85 feet. The record uses the list figure.
The statewide list codes the site as section 36, T156N, R31W; the Forest Lookouts page and the brief give 157N. The story gives no township.

notes_for_editor: The 1931 fire and destruction come from a Moorhead Daily News item as quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; the original newspaper was not read. The county list and the statewide list both give the 81-foot second tower and the 1966 footings note, but neither dates the second tower. The 70-foot first tower has no build date. No staffing records found. Current-site and access facts are not in any source read, so the access field is left out. Township discrepancy (156N vs 157N) is flagged for the editor; the agency correction does not change the township. Two searches used. No photos added.
